capabilities_done: VendorFrame (src/dng.rs, additive) carries black_repeat + black_level (validated: 1..=16 repeat, finite, >= 0, below white -> invalid_levels); samples may exceed the white up to max(white, full scale), as in DNG (develop's RangePolicy decides)

src/levels.rs: per-site masked-region means, saturation-plateau white (LightCraft white_from_data rule + a <= 90 % minority guard so a flat frame is not 'saturation'), measured_white = plateau or >= 16 samples at the code ceiling, else None (white stays named unread)
CR2: black = per-site mean of masked columns 2..left-2 of the maker-note SensorInfo area; white measured (350D: no saturation -> cr2_white_level_unread kept)
NEF: black = maker note 0x003D (14-bit units, scaled; Z6 252), else 0 (D1H, D70s); white measured (D1H plateau 3953, D70s 4080, Z6 4095 = ceiling reached)
CR3: black/white from Canon ColorData 0x4001 in the CTMD timed maker note (else CMT3) by version (R6 v33: black 512 x4, white 14008); CTMD records/items parsed with bounded budgets

ARW: black = raw IFD 0x7310 else the encrypted SR2SubIFD 0x7310 (src/sr2.rs: LightCraft's black-box-measured keystream for key 11 22 33 44 only; the recalled key-derivation for other keys deliberately not ported) -> 7S black 512; white not provable on the sample (kept unread)

RAF: black = raw IFD 0xF00A per CFA site (X-Trans 6x6, Bayer 2x2, or uniform; X-S10 1022); white measured inside the 0x0110/0x0111 crop (X-S10: none -> kept unread); uncompressed RAF (mode 0): 16-bit LE words, 12-bit LSB-first stream, 32-bit LE words MSB-first (0xF006 or non-12-bit), 0xF005 stride; rows checked before allocation
ORF: black = old-style maker note 0x1012 in 0x102C ValidBits units (C5060WZ: 0); white measured (plateau 4080)
RW2: black = 0x001C-0x001E per CFA site + 15 for formats 4/6 (LX7 142); white measured inside the 0x0004-0x0007 borders (LX7: none -> kept unread)
DESCRIPTOR scope/pending rewritten for levels, uncompressed RAF, remaining unread items and the converter NOT_PROVEN

Olympus compressed ORF: no permissively licensed decoder or bit-level description (LightCraft refuses it; a 2026-10-15 search found only libopenraw, LGPL, excluded) and no compressed-ORF CC0 sample in the corpus; not built.

Uncompressed RAF has no real-file proof: the corpus has no uncompressed modern RAF, and downloading a CC0 sample needs a direct Operator approval in chat for this builder (not given); synthetic packings only. Suggested sample: any raw.pixls.us Fujifilm 'uncompressed' X-Trans or X-A Bayer file.

White levels not provable from the corpus samples (no saturated region): CR2 350D (max 2962), ARW 7S (max 15540), RAF X-S10 (max 6216), RW2 LX7 (max 3216); kept as *_white_level_unread with the code ceiling as white. CR3 R6 uses its ColorData white 14008 (file-stated; the sample never reaches it, max 8181).
